overviewTitle: Giving teams control over prompts and AI operations
overviewDescription: Elacity Control Plane is an Ellavox AI product for managing prompts and AI agents across providers. It gives teams a way to version instructions, review changes and apply policies before publishing updates to their AI systems.

Operating these systems requires more than prompt editing. Teams need to see what agents are doing, receive useful alerts and respond when something changes. Approval processes, execution logs and provider integrations have to work together across the platform.

We developed notifications and automated action channels, integrated observability and guardrails, and implemented prompt policy checks and approval workflows. We also connected AI providers and added Stripe subscriptions and usage-based billing to support the commercial side of the product.

overviewTitle: Helping researchers explore new uses for existing medicines
overviewDescription: Every Cure uses AI to identify promising new uses for existing medicines. We helped build Orchard, a research platform where its teams can explore drug–disease relationships and review potential repurposing opportunities.

Researchers needed to narrow complex datasets, compare evidence and share exactly what they were looking at. Keeping filters, sorting and application state in sync was essential: refreshing a page or sending a link should not mean starting again.

We developed search and filtering tools that preserve research views in the URL, alongside sign-in, onboarding, administration and review workflows. We also refactored the frontend into reusable TypeScript components and added automated tests for key user journeys.

overviewTitle: Making clinical trial evidence easier to find and compare
overviewDescription: Confyde helps pharmaceutical and biotech teams work with clinical trial evidence. We helped build an AI-powered research workspace that lets users discover relevant studies, compare trial data and investigate questions about clinical development.

Research teams often have to work across separate sources to understand how studies differ and what their findings mean. The challenge was to bring complex information into a clear interface where users could search, inspect and compare the evidence.

The workspace combines retrieval-augmented generation with structured clinical data, interactive tables and visual summaries. Relevant source information supports AI-assisted analysis, while researchers can examine the data and interpret the findings themselves.

overviewTitle: Connecting students and organizations through structured recruitment workflows
overviewDescription: CuedIn is a two-sided recruitment platform connecting students with organizations. It brings applications, communication and candidate tracking into a shared ecosystem, while giving each organization its own workspace. The platform is designed for high-volume hiring pipelines with multiple steps and changing application statuses.

Recruitment teams need a clear view of candidates as they move through a hiring process. Students need to understand their progress and stay in contact with organizations. Supporting both sides in one platform also requires data separation, consistent application handling and reliable updates across different user workflows.

We developed multi-step application flows, dynamic status tracking, automated invitations and real-time chat, supported by interactive dashboards. A multi-tenant architecture separates organizational data. Server-driven logic, validated data flows, database optimization and asynchronous processing support the platform’s recruitment workflows and responsive frontend.

overviewDescription: JoinPeel is an online marketplace for locally grown products, connecting farmers and food producers with individual customers, restaurants, and food hubs. The platform brings product discovery, direct ordering, and conversations with growers into one place, with dedicated tools for sellers, buyers, ambassadors, and administrators.

The goal was to make direct trade easier for small and medium-sized farms and the communities around them. Growers needed a way to present their products and manage stock, while buyers needed to find nearby produce, request missing items, and follow orders without relying on intermediaries.

We developed the marketplace with searchable listings, a location map, grower profiles, checkout integrations, and order tracking. Buyers and sellers can message each other and switch roles within one account. Dedicated dashboards support administration and ambassador referrals, while email and SMS notifications communicate relevant updates.

overviewTitle: Bringing consultations and patient services into one online clinic
overviewDescription: The telemedicine clinic connects patients and doctors through synchronized web and mobile applications. It brings remote consultations together with appointment booking, document uploads, test requests, and medicine orders. The product supports interactions between patients, medical professionals, and external pharmacies, giving each group tools for its part of the care process.

The client needed a way for doctors to receive patients and conduct consultations remotely. Patients needed access to services from home, while doctors required tools suited to repeated daily use, including patient records, appointment schedules, and test data. Pharmacies also needed a way to manage orders placed through the applications.

We developed the web frontend and mobile applications for the online clinic. The interfaces support video, voice, and text communication, alongside profiles, booking, file uploads, and notifications. Synchronized web and mobile access connects these interactions with patient records, test requests, and pharmacy ordering within the wider platform.

overviewTitle: Connecting sales, customers, and warehouse operations
overviewDescription: Autobro is an integrated platform for an Austrian auto parts retailer, combining an online store, CRM, and digital warehouse. Customers use the store to find and order parts, while the retailer’s team manages customer records, supplier orders, delivery tracking, and stock locations through connected business tools.

The retailer needed to bring customer communication, order collection, sourcing, and logistics into a coordinated workflow. Its catalog drew on TecDoc and several supplier databases, making product data and API integration an important challenge. Warehouse staff also needed precise storage and picking information for individual goods.

We developed the storefront and connected it to a CRM with automatic order entry and status updates. The store includes detailed product filters, supplier-specific pricing, and customer accounts. We also built supplier ordering integrations and a digital warehouse with shelf locations, order assembly, and QR code and barcode generation.

overviewTitle: Bringing time, projects and team availability into one view
overviewDescription: Soft Bee Tracker brings time tracking, project management and team scheduling into one application. It combines real-time monitoring with calendars, leave records and reporting tools. A dashboard and administrative interface give managers a shared place to review the information collected through these workflows.

Managing a team requires more than a record of hours. Project activity needs to be viewed alongside schedules, sick leave and vacations. Reports also need to reflect the information a manager is looking for and the frequency at which that information is useful.

The platform combines time tracking and project management with calendar and leave-management features. Reporting tools automate report creation and allow users to adjust report frequency and content. The technical stack includes React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL and Strapi, with Material UI and Styled Components for the interface.

overviewTitle: Managing vehicle shipping from the first quote to delivery
overviewDescription: This logistics SaaS MVP brings vehicle transportation operations into one platform. It supports the workflow from a shipping quote to order creation, carrier assignment and delivery tracking. User management, financial reporting and document generation sit alongside the core transport process for logistics teams.

Vehicle shipping involves coordinating prices, carriers, locations, order statuses and documents. The project’s goal was to reduce manual work and give companies a central place to manage these operations. Different users also needed appropriate access to the information and actions relevant to their role.

We developed quote calculations, order management, carrier assignment and document generation, including invoices and bills of lading. The platform includes four business roles, invitations and Supabase row-level security. VIN checks, Google location suggestions, maps, file uploads and reporting support the operational workflow.

overviewTitle: Connecting open shifts with healthcare workers and their schedules
overviewDescription: GapNurse is a medical staffing platform for facilities and healthcare workers. Facilities publish assignments for their own employees and independent contractors, while workers use mobile apps to find opportunities that fit their schedules. The platform brings assignment details, scheduling, task progress, and payments into a shared web and mobile workflow.

The client wanted to help medical organizations find staff without relying on staffing agencies. This required more than a listing board: facilities needed to manage assignments, while workers needed to review shifts, track their time, complete tasks, and receive payment. Both sides needed synchronized information across the portal and mobile apps.

We developed the web portal and mobile applications for iOS and Android, with synchronized assignment and user information. The solution includes profiles, location and map features, booking, notifications, calls, and time tracking. An administration panel supports facility, employee, and assignment records, alongside feedback, ratings, and payment integration.

overviewTitle: Making culture-token discovery and wallet access easier to navigate
overviewDescription: This progressive web app brings culture-token discovery, wallet access and purchase flows into one product. It is designed for both experienced crypto users and people new to the category. A browser-based experience makes the platform accessible across devices without relying on an app-store installation.

Wallet setup, private keys and disconnected interfaces can make the first steps into crypto difficult. The project aimed to create a more approachable flow while connecting token exploration, funding and transactions within a consistent interface for retail users.

The solution combines an embedded Cubist wallet and CubeSigner key recovery with social sign-in, a token exploration page and Jupiter swap integration. Supabase supports the application stack alongside React and Next.js. Crypto deposits and on-ramp flows connect account access with the product’s transaction experience.

overviewTitle: Putting repeat purchasing and delivery status in one customer portal
overviewDescription: AlliedMedical is the distribution platform for Alliedmedical-Lenmax, a Canadian supplier of medical equipment and supplies. Its customers include emergency services, hospitals, fire departments, police departments, and home healthcare providers. The website combines a product catalog with organization accounts, purchasing tools, and access to current and past orders.

Organizational purchasing involves repeat product lists, different delivery addresses, and orders that may ship in parts. Customers need to see stock availability, reuse familiar orders, and understand what has not yet arrived. Administrators also need to maintain the catalog and manage customer access, invitations, and order information.

The platform combines catalog browsing with SKU-based quick ordering and reusable order templates. Customer accounts include order history, backorder reports, and separate shipping and billing address management. Administration tools cover product availability, categories, manufacturers, users, invitations, and order review, including the option to resubmit failed orders.

overviewTitle: Making seller priorities part of the property bidding process
overviewDescription: plumBid is a real estate platform for buyers, sellers, and agents participating in an online bidding process. Sellers define which terms matter most, including sales price, cash down payment, escrow length, and contingencies. Buyers use those priorities to shape offers rather than considering the asking price alone.

The project addressed a negotiation process in which buyers may not know how a seller weighs competing terms. Sellers, in turn, need to compare offers that differ in more than price. The platform needed to communicate these preferences and support offer adjustments within a shared, real-time auction environment.

The delivered platform brings seller preference settings together with a calculation system that determines bid incentives using those priorities and economic conditions. It includes profiles for three user roles, an updated bidding timer, chat, file uploads, scheduling, and email communication to support participation throughout the online offer process.

overviewTitle: Connecting recycling activity with retail rewards
overviewDescription: Trovr and Trovr Merchant are connected mobile applications built around rewards for recycling. Consumers earn points when they recycle eligible containers through participating machines, then exchange those points for vouchers. The companion merchant app supports redemption in shops, connecting recycling activity with purchases from participating retailers.

The project aimed to give people a practical incentive to recycle and a clear route from returning a container to using a reward. That experience needed to connect consumers, recycling infrastructure, and retailers, with synchronized apps supporting both the customer’s journey and voucher redemption at the shop.

We developed the Trovr and Trovr Merchant applications using React Native, TypeScript, and Firebase. The scope included user profiles, QR and barcode generation and scanning, push notifications, location features, and third-party integrations. App synchronization and deep links support the connections between recycling activity, rewards, and merchant interactions.
